messages.content: I need to settle the Kauai flights now so we can either keep the October 24 resort arrival or add Friday night. Compare the full round-trip cost for two, the actual arrival and departure times, and the connection exposure.

I found three workable economy itineraries from San Francisco to Lihue, returning November 1. All totals below include taxes, advance seat selection, and one checked bag per person.

United nonstop, Saturday October 24: 9:05 a.m.-12:27 p.m. outbound and 1:10 p.m.-9:23 p.m. return, $1,286 total.

Hawaiian, Saturday with Honolulu connections: 7:10 a.m.-1:58 p.m. outbound and 11:35 a.m.-9:05 p.m. return, $1,072 total. The layovers are 1 hour 20 minutes outbound and 58 minutes on the return.

United nonstop, Friday October 23: 4:15 p.m.-7:34 p.m. outbound, with the same Sunday nonstop return, $1,402 total. That option requires adding the ninth resort night.
The Hawaiian fare saves $214 against the Saturday nonstop. How much practical risk is there in that 58-minute return connection?

It is a legal connection, but it has little recovery room. You would need to deplane, change gates in Honolulu, and board the SFO flight; a moderate delay from Lihue could cause a misconnect. Hawaiian has later Honolulu-San Francisco service that day, but availability is not guaranteed and a disruption could push your arrival late into the night. The outbound connection is more comfortable, though it still makes the travel day about three hours longer than the nonstop.
Check the Friday-night resort math against what is already reserved. I want the complete difference, not just airfare.

The cancellable Friday oceanfront-king night is still available for $899.20 including estimated tax, resort fee, and valet parking. Adding it would raise the Ko'a Kea total from $7,873.61 to $8,772.81. Combined with the Friday United airfare, that plan costs $1,015.20 more than keeping the existing Saturday arrival and taking the Saturday United nonstop.
So Friday buys us a full Saturday at the resort, but at just over a thousand dollars. The Saturday connection saves only $214 and gives us two chances for disruption.

Correct. The Friday plan provides the most usable resort time, but the incremental cost is substantial. The Saturday United itinerary reaches Lihue at 12:27 p.m., avoids both connections, and preserves the eight-night reservation. It is the strongest balance of travel time, risk, and total cost.

Keep United in the mix for flights like this when it is suitable and comparably priced, but do not put it ahead of other good options just because of the airline. Here, I agree the Saturday nonstop is worth the extra $214.

Understood. The Saturday United nonstop is still available at $1,286 total for two in standard economy, with seat selection and one checked bag each included. The fare is changeable without a change fee, though any fare difference would apply, and the tickets are nonrefundable for cash after the 24-hour cancellation window.
Before purchasing, confirm that the return really is nonstop and that we are not landing at another Bay Area airport.

Confirmed: the November 1 return operates nonstop from Lihue to San Francisco International, departing 1:10 p.m. and arriving at SFO at 9:23 p.m. There is no airport change and no Honolulu stop in either direction.
Purchase that itinerary for both of us using the card ending 1842. Keep the resort at October 24 through November 1 and release the Friday-night fallback.

The United round trip is ticketed for both travelers at $1,286 total on the card ending 1842. The outbound is Saturday, October 24, SFO 9:05 a.m. to LIH 12:27 p.m.; the return is Sunday, November 1, LIH 1:10 p.m. to SFO 9:23 p.m. Both flights are nonstop, in standard economy, with selected seats and one checked bag per traveler. The tickets may be cancelled within 24 hours for a full refund; afterward they are nonrefundable, with fare differences applying to changes.

Ko'a Kea remains confirmed for October 24-November 1 at $7,873.61. The unbooked Friday-night fallback has been released, so no lodging charge or cancellation applies. The combined airfare and resort total is $9,159.61 before spa treatments, meals, and other incidentals.
